historical_reviews.v3_1: A readable member document is insufficient unless its URI and MemoryId are linked by the selected System Memory collection and its capacity/status fields are internally valid.

original_test_intent: Read one Memory resource belonging to the selected ComputerSystem and validate its identity, capacity and health as a bounded, read-only DIMM/resource inventory check.
original_method: Resolve a member URI from the advertised System Memory collection, issue one authenticated GET with trusted TLS, validate the returned resource identity and approved fields, and retain a redacted snapshot without changing memory or logs.
manual_activity: Provision the reusable trusted Redfish credential/TLS provider, Memory member schema and identifier-redaction policy; no per-run physical DIMM action or disruptive approval is required afterward.
required_inputs: One collection-derived Memory member URI and MemoryId
Trusted TLS and least-privilege credential provider
agent_execution_scope: Bind endpoint and certificate to the intended BMC
Select exactly one advertised member URI
GET the member once under a timeout
Capture status/headers and restricted raw hash
Validate URI, MemoryId, capacity, status/health and approved schema
Export a redacted member report and no-mutation audit
engineer_actions: Maintain reusable member schema and DIMM-identifier privacy policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: curl/jq and GET fit the member read, but fixed `system`, a free-form MEMORY_ID, `-k` and full JSON export can select the wrong resource or disclose restricted inventory.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With trusted TLS, take one member URI only from the selected System's Memory collection, require 2xx Redfish JSON, validate exact URI/MemoryId plus approved capacity/status fields, and export a redacted record.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The single Memory member GET and 15/10 timing remain; no SystemId, MemoryId, capacity, health value or hardware locator is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a link-aware Redfish member validator that proves collection provenance before checking member identity, size and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces free-form identity, unsafe TLS/credentials and readability-only acceptance with collection linkage, schema/type validation and privacy controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Validates one selected Memory member in depth; collection completeness and aggregate capacity remain the preceding collection case's responsibility.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC inventory may describe physical or logical memory differently from host-visible capacity. This read does not test ECC injection, memory training, bandwidth or OS usability.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent if it preserves the advertised collection/member URI, certificate identity, exact MemoryId and field-level evidence. Host `dmidecode` or OS memory totals may corroborate but cannot replace the BMC resource contract.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC/System identity, firmware and Memory schema
HTTP status/content type and restricted raw response hash
Approved capacity/status/health fields and redacted locator summary

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master item, member path and GET consistently describe one Memory member read. Fixed IDs, unsafe access and weak criteria are execution-quality gaps rather than competing source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The member-read purpose and resource family are explicit; normal secure Redfish, collection-resolution, schema and redaction configuration are sufficient.

review_improvement: Turns a caller-selected readable JSON dump into a collection-provenance, identity, capacity and health validation with privacy-safe evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Redfish Memory URI can return valid JSON while naming a stale, wrong-System or otherwise unrelated member. The decisive evidence is therefore the chain from the selected System's advertised Memory collection to the exact member, followed by agreement between the requested URI, `@odata.id` and MemoryId. Capacity and health need typed checks because human-readable output alone misses zero, absent or malformed inventory fields; sensitive part, serial and locator data must not be exported indiscriminately.
